conflicts.fact: Wet-road braking distance relative to dry
conflicts.versions: L6 Learned says a wet road (a = 2.5 m/s²) 'doubles the braking distance'. This is consistent with the table (10 m→20 m). Also L6 Predict says a matatu at 36 km/h needs about 20 m to stop, which matches the fact sheet. No contradiction found, so this is not a real conflict.
